output.reason: [ev-99f86df45975] says the Helm option `enableRuntimeDeviceDetection` "is now deprecated and is a no-op" in 1.16. Any value an operator sets therefore stops being honoured now, so this is setting-ignored. It is not deprecation, which would mean the option still works today. The evidence doesn't say what changes beyond the value being ignored, so severity is low.

correction.statement: In Cilium 1.16.0 the Helm value enableRuntimeDeviceDetection is deprecated and a no-op: any value set for it is no longer honoured.

consequence.statement: The Helm option enableRuntimeDeviceDetection is a no-op in 1.16: any value set for it has no effect.
consequence.remediation: Remove enableRuntimeDeviceDetection from your Helm values and check that the current device detection behaviour is acceptable without it.
